newsitem.title: USA: Earthquake hits Easter Island region in Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits Easter Island region in Pacific.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 7.1 on the open-ended Richter scale was recorded in the Easter Island region in the South Pacific on Thursday, the U.S. Geological Survey said.
"This was a big earthquake," said Rebecca Phipps, a spokeswoman for the Colorado-based centre which tracks seismic activity around the world.
Phipps said the quake occurred in the ocean about 415 miles (670 km) northwest of Hangaroa in the Easter Island chain in the Pacific at 2:14 a.m./4:14 EDT (0818 GMT).
There were no reports of damage or injuries.
